Name: Balanced Better Mixed Seeds
Author: shadeinthestars
Description:
This is a config file for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url]﻿ that makes it so that more profitable crops are much rarer than less profitable crops.

Calculated based on how much a crop sells for on average per year

Please merge this folder with the BetterMixedSeeds folder (and replace the config file that is already there).
